    def to_json(self) -> str:
        """
        Convert the Version object to a compact JSON object string.

        The JSON object contains the keys ``major``, ``minor``, ``patch``,
        ``prerelease``, and ``build`` in that order, always emitting all
        five keys. This is the same output as
        :func:`semver.dumps_version`.

        :return: the compact JSON object as a string

        >>> semver.Version(3, 2, 1).to_json()
        '{"major":3,"minor":2,"patch":1,"prerelease":null,"build":null}'
        """
        from .jsonio import dumps_version

        return dumps_version(self)
